'''Volume 4: Friends and Families''' is the fourth of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
'''''SISTERS?! OH, BROTHER!'''''
* [[Almond]] and [[Hazel]] go to {{MPJ|Squirtle}}'s house to meet Squirtle's five sisters, but the Squirtle household has a terrifying surprise for our heroes!
* When Almond is in the hospital, Hazel buys flowers from [[Peanut]]'s amorous florist brother [[Pistachio]].
* Hazel shrinks to a size only inches tall! Now how will she get Almond to notice her?!
* A game of hide and seek goes terribly wrong for Peanut and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}}. Can the weakest human and most timid Pokémon survive in a cruel world?
* These stories and many, many more!

==Important events==
* [[Pistachio]] and his {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} are introduced.
* {{TP|Peanut|Charmander}} and Bulbasaur have their first battle.
* [[Peanut]], {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}}, and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}} meet {{p|Onix}} again through a cave connected to where the [[PPP07|Stone of Adventure]] was located.

==Trivia==
* In the Pokémon File at the end of this volume, which also appears in [[Pokémon Sleepover]], {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} is identified with the nickname "Bulba." Despite this, she is never referred to with a nickname in the English translation by any characters in the regular manga pages.
* At the end of the book, there is a joke advertisement for {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|5}} teasing that {{MPJ|Arbok}} and {{MPJ|Wigglytuff}} will get married, prompting [[Almond]] to discover who he has feelings for.
